text: grep -n "Input\|Output\|label_global\|///" src/codegen_support/runtime/arrays/hash_get.rs | head -20:  #580). It costs one move on the found path because 27:/// the probe has already computed the address. Both `x4` and the x86_64 mirror `r8` are 28:/// caller-saved and were already clobbered by this helper's own probing and key comparisons, so 29:/// exposing them adds no constraint on existing callers. 38: emitter.label_global("__rt_hash_get"); 152:/// Emits the x86_64 Linux variant of `__rt_hash_get`. 153:/// Uses SysV ABI: rdi=hash_table_ptr, rsi=key_lo, rdx=key_hi (key_hi=-1 means integer key, otherwise string key with rsi=ptr, rdx=len). 154:/// Returns: rax=found (1 or 0), rdi=value_lo, rsi=value_hi, rcx=value_tag, r8=matching entry address (0 on miss). 155:/// `r8` mirrors the AArch64 `x4` entry-address output used by the by-reference `foreach` element 156:/// fetch (issue #580); the probe loop already builds the address there, so only the miss path 157:/// needs an explicit clear.
